name: Kogda plachut pionery: Lushshaja v Adu
original_name: Когда плачут пионеры: Лучшая в Аду
source:
What is starting from scratch? What if everything suddenly starts anew and under any conditions, will start anew, turning a person's life into a living Hell? Imagine: every morning is a breakdown of time, every memory is a shadow of a long-gone day, every attachment is just a repetition of the old pain. The inability to change the past is a curse, but the realization that the future is also predetermined breaks the will.
The world is locked in an eternal loop, and SHE is a prisoner of this nightmarish dance. ITS triumphs are nullified, ITS losses are resurrected again and again. Love becomes the agony of foresight, friendship the hypocrisy of the knower. Pain is inevitable, every fall is a foregone conclusion. There is no progress, no redemption, just an endless replication of pain and frustration. The desire for change is absurd, for all efforts are futile. Free will is an illusion trapped in a cage of eternal return. Consciousness rushes in search of a way out, but finds only a reflection in the endless mirror of repeated events. This is not life, but a sophisticated torture, where the executioner is reality itself. Eternal Hell is not fire and brimstone, but an endless echo of familiar footsteps.
A man trapped in a corner can only choose between death and life. And if life means giving up old ideas, then he will throw them away without regret. Hell is not a place, it is a state of mind. And if the soul is already broken, Hell is just a catalyst that accelerates the process of decomposition, turning It into a desperate beast, ready to do anything for survival. And who would dare judge HER? Who will throw a stone at someone who has passed through the crucible of suffering and chosen to live, even at the cost of their humanity? Perhaps this is the true test: to keep yourself together, even when there is only darkness around. But is it possible?
Consciousness is shattered, personality is broken up into fragments, poisoned by the knowledge of the futility of effort. The desire for something dies, buried under the thickness of repetitions. Hell is not fire and brimstone lakes, it is monotony, infinity, hopelessness, enclosed within the framework of a familiar reality that has ceased to be such. SHE was Sisyphus, doomed to carry that damned rock forever, knowing that it would always fall down and crush her.
Everything was taken away from her, breaking her and her everyday world. SHE knows she's in Hell. Your own personal HELL.
BUT IN THIS HELL, THIS PIONEER WILL BE THE BEST.
THE BEST IN HELL.
